newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa UAP announce alliance plans.
newsitem.headline: Axa UAP announce alliance plans.

text.p: French insurers Axa and UAP are to reveal plans on Tuesday for an alliance between the two groups, a UAP spokesman said.
The insurers' boards are due to meet this morning and have requested the suspension of the shares on the Paris bourse, the spokesman said.
A statement is due this morning on the deal, the spokesman added.
French newspapers, speaking of a merger between the two, said an alliance of UAP and Axa would create the world's biggest insurance company.
Talk of an Axa takeover has been pushing UAP shares up on the Paris stock exchange recently.
